_comment: WIMP-nucleon SI, DAMIC-M projection, 1x1 channel only, 1.3 kg-day exposure (mass_kg=1.0, livetime_days=1.3). Diffusion/noise/halo are DAMIC-M values sourced ONLY from pydme + this repo's own existing defaults (see configs/wimp_nucleon_generate_si_damicm_halo.json's _comment for exact provenance) -- NOT from the (excluded) DamicMSignal-main repo. Background model (flat rate 5478.75 events/(kg*yr*keV) + Fig.9-digitized 1x1 background efficiency curve) is REUSED AS-IS from the DAMIC 2016 SNOLAB reproduction (configs/wimp_nucleon_damic2016_limit_repro.json) per explicit instruction -- DAMIC-M has no background model of its own here yet; this is a placeholder, not a DAMIC-M measurement. Etrue_min_eV: Scaled from DAMIC 2016's 60 eV floor by the sigma_pix ratio (1.8 -> 0.16 e-, ~11.3x): 60/11.3 ~= 5.3 eV, rounded to 5.0 eV. NOT an independently validated DAMIC-M threshold -- a rough physically-motivated estimate only, per explicit user request to test this alongside the floor60 baseline. UPDATED: sigma grid extended to 1e-45 (50 pts) -- the original 1e-42 lower bound left the true crossing unresolved near the grid edge for this much more sensitive projection. UPDATED: Etrue_npoints raised from 16 to 30 -- 16 points spread over the wider 5-4000eV log-range (vs floor60s 60-4000eV) gave visibly coarser resolution and produced an artificially flat exclusion curve; 30 points resolves real mass-dependent structure (verified directly: a 16 vs 30 point test at 1kg-year changed values by ~20-25% and revealed a real V-shaped minimum around 2 GeV that 16 points washed out).
